items.title: United Cement Company – Enterprise Digital Transformation
items.description: ErpCollab Ltd delivered a fully integrated digital platform for United Cement Company, connecting customers, vendors, dealers, HR, and management with Infor ERP LN to automate key business processes and improve operational efficiency.
highlights: Corporate Website & CMS — Modern responsive website with content management for news, announcements, and careers.
Customer Ordering Portal — Self-registration, online ordering, approval workflow, and seamless Infor ERP LN integration.
Vendor Self-Service Portal — Online registration, document submission, automated approval, and one-click ERP Business Partner creation.
Dealer Portal — Self-service ordering, real-time order tracking, and improved dealer-sales collaboration.
AI-Powered Recruitment Portal — AI CV parsing, vacancy publishing, end-to-end recruitment workflow with automated notifications.
Infor ERP LN Integration — Secure data synchronization across all portals, reducing manual effort and improving data accuracy.

items.title: E-Commerce Platform
items.description: A scalable e-commerce solution with product management, secure payments, order tracking, and a seamless shopping experience.
